assets.name: texture-pine-paper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium website background texture. Create a full-bleed flat top-down scan of dark forest pine green paper that was gently crumpled and flattened again. Entire image is paper, no objects, edges, text, symbols, borders or watermarks. Rich deep desaturated green centered around #163d32 / #153b30. Natural branching creases, soft shallow relief, fine cotton fibers and matte pigment, handmade archival paper. Visibly tactile and organic but restrained low contrast so ivory website text stays legible everywhere. No shiny foil, no rock, no leather, no dramatic directional light, no black shadows or bright highlights, no vignetting. Broad irregular crumple structure with fine smaller wrinkles, consistent illumination. Landscape 3:2 high resolution seamless-looking surface; the pattern should be suitable for a large footer backdrop.
